newsitem.title: USA: U.S. family killed in apparent murder-suicide.
newsitem.headline: U.S. family killed in apparent murder-suicide.

text.p: A father apparently shot to death his wife and daughter in their California home before turning the gun on himself, officials said Monday.

A 38-year-old man, his 34-year-old wife and their 13-year- old daughter were all found dead of bullet wounds to the head in a house in the Sacramento suburb of Rosemont Monday, the Sacramento County Sheriff's Department said.

Investigators said they believed the father killed his wife and daughter before taking his own life. Relatives told detectives that the family had been having "personal problems", the sheriff's department said.
The names of the family members were not being released until next of kin had been notified.
The wife's mother became worried and went to the house Monday after finding out that her daughter and son-in-law had not turned up for work and that her granddaughter had not arrived at school.

She was apparently unable to get into the house but, looking through the window, saw her daughter slumped on the couch. After she called authorities, deputies entered the house and found all three family members dead. The sheriff's department did not say when it believed the killings took place.
